question: The Battle of Chandawar was fought between Mohammad Ghori and Jaichand of Kannauj of the ______ dynasty.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gahadavala.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the battle of Chandawar (1194 CE) King Jaichand was defeated by Muhammad Gori. 
 
• The present geographical location of Chandawar is Etawah district in U.P. at the bank of river
